Name: SuperAdmin
Description: Full platform access with all permissions. Assigned to platform administrators only.

Name: ClubAdmin
Description: Full access within a club. Manages users and teams and club-level settings.

Name: Athlete
Description: Player role. Accesses assigned games and reflection content via the mobile app.

Name: Parent
Description: Guardian of one or more Athletes. Accesses linked athlete progress via the mobile app.

Name: Coach
Description: Coaches one or more teams. Accesses team rosters and content via the mobile app.

Name: Director
Description: Full access within a club. Distinguished from ClubAdmin as a separate club-elevated portal role.
